accept-v09-drones3d.reason: cannot run on live: the bench throws unless SITE, BASE_SITE and PRE_SITE are all http://localhost or 127.0.0.1 ("a local release; never the live site"), and it needs BASE_SITE (build 631fd5f) and PRE_SITE (build 06bef1f, not kept). The lead recorded V1-V9 and the green half of V10 locally.

accept-v09-next.reason: needs mocks: it fakes /api/catalog (12 scenes in a chosen order) and /api/superspl/explore in every browser context (page.route) and asserts the order N visits them; against the live catalogue N1 N2 N3 have no fixed expected order. The mocks are in-browser and would not write to the live API, so a run against the live static site is possible if the lead wants one, but the brief said to skip a bench that needs mocks.

accept-v09-c.reason: cannot target the live site: it starts its own throwaway API on a temp data folder with a made-up admin password and serves dist/ itself (reads no SITE); it exercises the admin Save and Publish, which must not be done on live.
